articles.title: What’s behind the AI industry’s latest warnings of doom?
articles.summary: On Equity, we discussed the AI industry's latest debate about whether it poses an existential threat to humanity.

articles.title: Obama urges Democrats to have a ‘clear plan’ for AI safeguards
articles.summary: Obama recently said that Democrats need to make artificial intelligence one of their “central agendas” and “have a very clear plan” to address concerns around the technology’s economic impact and safety.

articles.title: Trump and Mike Johnson think the AI industry is overreacting

articles.title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised’ to go public in 2026
articles.summary: While OpenAI has filed confidentially for an IPO, the company will not be going public this year, according to CEO Sam Altman.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO outlines plan to slow AI development
articles.summary: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman seem to agree that it's time to "pace the frontier." What would that actually look like?
